changelog.notes: Schema 2.0. Block renamed to site. Harmonised variable names, units and English descriptions. Country and crop added to site data. Administrative names kept as adm1 to adm3. Coordinates checked against country borders.

study.title: Cassava Tricot 21B
study.description: Second season cassava trials 21B (6 varieties). The source says six varieties; the data hold eight genotypes. Data produced by IITA with RAB under the CGIAR Research Program on Roots, Tubers and Bananas. Participant gender was inferred from first names in the field sheet; names that do not show gender are left blank

location_privacy.method: Site coordinates rounded to two decimals (a cell of about 1.1 km), so the published point lies within 800 m of the recorded one and neighbouring sites share a point.
location_privacy.admin_names: Administrative names kept as adm1 to adm3, capitalisation standardised
location_privacy.gap_filling: Sites without a point take the mean of located sites with the same administrative names, pooled across all published trials (adm2+adm3, then adm3, then adm2, within 30 km of their mean), before rounding. coordinate_source names the level, coordinate_uncertainty_m adds the spread of the pool.
